title: AI-mediated Interactive Health Messaging for Community Health Promotion in Low-Middle Income Countries.
summary: HIBA was tested with community groups in Lebanon and Jordan to improve access to understandable health information in text and audio.
source_collection: ITU AI for Good: Innovate for Impact (2025)
account: The HIBA chatbot combines retrieval, language models, speech recognition, and speech synthesis. Testing included groups of 6, 20, and 50 participants, with feedback used to refine language, usability, and content. It supports 28 languages. The source describes access and user-testing work, while improved health literacy and health decisions remain expected outcomes.
purpose: Make reliable health information more accessible across language and literacy barriers.

ratings.reason: The chatbot was tested with community groups, but the source does not report an amount of improvement in health literacy, health decisions, or health.
Community-health support is described without an observed operational result.
Reduced misinformation and health disparities are expected effects.

ai_role.statement: The contributor describes the system and its proposed or reported contribution. This collection entry does not independently isolate the effect of AI from the surrounding workflow.

evidence.citation: Contributed use case in International Telecommunication Union, AI for Good: Innovate for Impact, 2025. Information current as of June 2025. The reported outcomes are attributed to the submitting project, not an independent outcome evaluation by ITU.
evidence.title: Use Case 10: AI-mediated Interactive Health Messaging for Community Health Promotion in Low-Middle Income Countries.

produced_by: The contributor describes the application and its setting in the cited entry. Conditions sufficient to reproduce the reported benefit have not been established.
must_hold: Requirements for reproducing the benefit need to be evaluated in the new setting. The collection entry does not establish that its reported results will recur.

headline: HIBA offers multilingual health information in Lebanon and Jordan

revisions.change: Added the sourced case with separate benefit depth, beneficiary, evidence confidence, and outcome status assessments.

claim_basis: The makers' report is on file. There is no independent source and no finding by a regulator or court.
